title: simulation conformance review (the reviewer's own record)

findings.description: One entry per inadequacy found. An empty array is a clean review; nothing else records one.

blocking.description: The reviewer's own call on whether this stops the round. The only machine-readable field here, because nothing human reads this record before the stage routes on it: the gate is `any(blocking)`, so a finding worth stopping for has to say so rather than encode it in a severity word.

finding.description: What the check does, what the testpoint's intent asked for, and where the two part company. Prose: whoever reads it next is deciding what to change, not counting categories.
